questions.title: Series Sum One to N
questions.description:
Read a non-negative integer N and print the sum 1 + 2 + ... + N using a for loop.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print the sum as a 64-bit integer.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 100000

questions.title: Factorial Calculator
questions.description:
Read a non-negative integer N and print N! (N factorial) using a for loop. Use a 64-bit accumulator (0! = 1).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N! as a 64-bit integer.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 20

questions.title: Countdown Printer
questions.description:
Read a non-negative integer N and print every integer from N down to 0 (inclusive), each on its own line, using a while loop.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N, N-1, ..., 1, 0 each on its own line.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 1000

questions.title: Count Inputs Until Zero
questions.description:
Read integers one by one until a 0 is encountered. Count the number of non-zero integers read (excluding the terminating 0) using a while loop.

Input Format:
A sequence of space- or newline-separated integers, terminated by 0.

Output Format:
Print the count of non-zero integers as an integer.

Constraints:
At least one integer is provided (the terminating 0); each integer is in [-1000000, 1000000].

questions.title: Repeated Greeting Printer
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print the word "Hi" on its own line exactly N times using a for loop.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N lines, each containing the word "Hi".

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000

Hi

Hi

questions.title: Multiplication Table Row Printer
questions.description:
Read an integer N and print N*1, N*2, ..., N*10 each on its own line using a for loop.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print 10 lines, the i-th containing N * i for i from 1 to 10.

Constraints:
-1000 <= N <= 1000

questions.title: Sum of Even Numbers Up to N
questions.description:
A math drill reads an integer N and prints the sum of all even numbers from 1 to N (inclusive) using a for loop with the continue statement to skip odd numbers.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print the sum as a 64-bit integer.

Constraints:
0 <= N <= 1000000

questions.title: Attendance Sheet Printer
questions.description:
A teacher reads the number of students in a class followed by their single-word names, and prints an indexed attendance sheet.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer N (number of students).
Next N lines: one single-word NAME per line.

Output Format:
Print N lines, the i-th line containing "<i>. <NAME>" (1-based index).

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000, 1 <= length(NAME) <= 50

questions.title: Integer Digit Count Drill
questions.description:
A digit counter reads an integer (which may be negative) and prints the number of decimal digits it contains. Use a while loop.

Input Format:
A single integer N (may be negative).

Output Format:
Print the digit count.

Constraints:
-1000000000 <= N <= 1000000000

questions.title: First N Multiples of Seven
questions.description:
A number-theory drill reads N and prints the first N positive multiples of 7 (7, 14, 21, ...) each on its own line, using a for loop.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N lines, the i-th containing 7 * i.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000

questions.title: Prime Number Checker
questions.description:
A primality tester reads a positive integer N and prints "Prime" or "Not Prime" using a for loop that breaks early when a divisor is found.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print "Prime" if N is prime (greater than 1 and divisible only by 1 and itself), otherwise "Not Prime".

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000000

questions.title: Fibonacci Sequence Printer
questions.description:
A Fibonacci generator reads N and prints the first N Fibonacci numbers (starting from 0, 1) each on its own line using a for loop and a 64-bit accumulator.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N lines: the i-th line contains the i-th Fibonacci number (F0 = 0, F1 = 1, F2 = 1, F3 = 2, ...).

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 80

questions.title: GCD Using Euclidean Algorithm
questions.description:
A number-theory tool reads two non-negative integers A and B and prints their greatest common divisor (GCD) using the Euclidean algorithm with a while loop.

Input Format:
Two space-separated non-negative integers A and B.

Output Format:
Print the GCD as a 64-bit integer.

Constraints:
0 <= A, B <= 1000000000

questions.title: Digit Sum Calculator
questions.description:
A digit-sum drill reads an integer (possibly negative) and prints the sum of its decimal digits using a while loop. Use a compound assignment to accumulate the running sum.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print the sum of digits.

Constraints:
-1000000000 <= N <= 1000000000

questions.title: First N Primes Printer
questions.description:
A prime-sequence generator reads N and prints the first N prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ...) each on its own line. Use a while loop to count primes and an inner for loop with break to test primality.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N lines, the i-th containing the i-th prime.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 1000

questions.title: Password Retry Simulator
questions.description:
A login system stores a 4-digit PIN. It then reads up to 3 attempts. If any attempt matches the PIN, print "Unlocked" and stop reading; otherwise after 3 wrong attempts print "Locked". Use a do-while loop.

Input Format:
Line 1: integer PIN (the correct PIN).
Next lines: integer ATTEMPT values, up to 3 attempts.

Output Format:
Print "Unlocked" on the first match, or "Locked" if all 3 attempts are wrong.

Constraints:
0 <= PIN <= 9999, 0 <= ATTEMPT <= 9999

questions.title: Collatz Conjecture Step Counter
questions.description:
A math exploration tool reads a positive integer N and counts how many steps the Collatz process takes to reach 1, where each step is:
- if N is even: N = N / 2
- if N is odd:  N = 3 * N + 1

Use a while loop and an if-else inside it. Print the step count.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print the number of steps to reach 1.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100000

questions.title: Star Pyramid Pattern Printer
questions.description:
A pattern printer reads the height N and prints a centered pyramid of '*' characters of that height, using nested for loops. Each row i (1-indexed) has (N - i) leading spaces followed by (2i - 1) stars.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print N lines forming the pyramid.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 30

questions.title: Prime Factorization Printer
questions.description:
A factorization tool reads an integer N >= 2 and prints all of its prime factors in non-decreasing order, each on its own line. Use a while loop that divides out each prime factor as many times as possible.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
Print one prime factor per line, with repeats for multiplicity.

Constraints:
2 <= N <= 1000000000

questions.title: Armstrong Number Range Finder
questions.description:
An Armstrong number is an integer that equals the sum of its own digits each raised to the power of the number of digits (e.g. 153 = 1^3 + 5^3 + 3^3). Read a closed range [LOW, HIGH] and print every Armstrong number in that range, each on its own line. Use nested loops and a manual power computation (no math library).

Input Format:
Two space-separated integers LOW and HIGH.

Output Format:
Print every Armstrong number in [LOW, HIGH] on its own line, in ascending order.

Constraints:
0 <= LOW <= HIGH <= 100000
